idea.name: Commercial facility cleaning subcontracting via cold email, vendor portals and government bids
idea.one_liner: Spin a residential cleaning company into a commercial facility-services arm that wins subcontracts from national facility management firms (e.g. 82 bank branches), registers on corporate vendor portals, bids federal/state contracts with a dedicated bidder, and runs high-volume cold email from ~20 inboxes

ideas.delivery: Local lead cleaner/team per region recruited by a recruiter; background checks, higher insurance, access codes; pricing matrix; owner and VA manage while holding full-time jobs
